newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme agrees to buy NeozymeII.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme agrees to buy NeozymeII.

text.p: Genzyme Corp said Friday it has reached an agreement in principle to acquire Neozyme II for $45 per unit in cash.

Genzyme said each Neozyme II unit consists of one share of Neozyme II callable common stock and one callable warrant to purchase two shares of Genzyme General Division common stock and 0.135 share of Genzyme Tissue Repair Division common stock. There are 2,415,000 Neozyme II units outstanding.
Genzyme said the transaction would close later this year if both parties reach a definitive agreement.
Neozyme II researches, develops and tests products for treating cystic fibrosis under contract with Genzyme.
Genzyme develops and markets pharmaceuticals and develops biological products to treat cartilage damage, severe burns, and chronic skin ulcers.
